Caldera Logistics Acquires Route-Planning Start-Up

7 October—Global freight group Caldera Logistics has completed its acquisition of Meridiem Routes, a small but inventive software firm specializing in delivery optimization. The acquisition will enable Caldera to accelerate its research into cutting empty running across its European fleet. – [1] –.

Dr. Helena Varga, who established Meridiem Routes more than a decade ago, has played an essential role in the firm’s success. – [2] –. Following the merger, she will transition to a position that aligns more closely to her original orientation. She will serve as chief technology adviser. “I am pleased to concentrate on the modelling work and to let the new team run the business day to day,” Dr. Varga said.

Meridiem Routes is well known for its generous profit-sharing arrangement. Every member of staff receives a bonus each quarter, based on the firm’s results. – [3] –. While this arrangement has helped Meridiem attract outstandingly talented engineers, there is concern that senior staff may leave after the merger, since Caldera operates no comparable scheme. – [4] –.
